summary: Accepted for frozen synthetic-input/protocol integrity only. Independent reviewer replay of the exact frozen generator matched all 27 generated files byte-for-byte, including the fixture manifest; all 31 frozen entry hashes and lengths pass. Six construction contracts and private figure were independently reviewed. Staged chronology is consistent with local file metadata and worker/root testimony; it is not independently timestamp-attested. No C6 candidate was read or executed. Private case geometry remains withheld from this public summary.
scope: Technical protocol/fixture review only; no candidate behavior, accuracy, real route, endpoint ownership or human acceptance.

findings.detail: 31/31 freeze entries actual SHA256 and bytes length equal; public C2 result hashes match frozen protocol/manifest; copied generator matches protocol pin.
Exact generator independently executed only inside reviewer-owned directory; 27/27 files equal original frozen bytes, including generated manifest and contactsheet.

6/6 dimensions/raw RGBA lengths, PNG/RGBA equality, opaque alpha, grayscale RGB, known mask bboxes, query-to-construction relations, distinct positive finite width inputs and explicit construction/anchor labels pass. See private checks without exposing geometry.

Frozen classes offer positive, perturbation, negative, visibility and competing-evidence controls. Protocol preserves raw component evidence, unknown/fallback distinctions and ambiguity. They are input opportunities, not guaranteed candidate outcomes.

Independently inspected generated contactsheet with view_image; intended analytic shapes and preview marks visible. Preview marks are absent from evaluation raster; explicit construction labels prevent real-course truth claims.

Current local mtimes show protocol/generator before generated inputs, then validation/inspection, then freeze manifest and public result. Protocol has order assertions but no embedded UTC timestamp. No immutable external timestamp or independent no-inspection audit is present. Root scoped release asserts source freeze already exists. Scope remains procedural withholding only.
Generator imports standard Python, NumPy, Pillow only; no candidate import. This reviewer read/executed no C6 candidate. Final files cannot independently prove historic noninspection by other agents.

Root confirms C2 fixture-freeze hash ca6049549ab188fd879c5913d6df5cc5f9f299eb83ca6c9afe09b31a61130ac0 was announced before the C6 source-freeze message, and E305 completion preceded that source-freeze message. R305 guard release followed C6 source freeze 9ecd88635ed69ca8fb8e44ff044ac1e8fd704133c5687685b9a3114893ed9cd0. This is coordinator-observed event ordering/testimony, not independent cryptographic UTC proof.

limits: Acceptance covers fixture/protocol integrity and same-environment replay only.
No C6 candidate execution until separate R306 authorization.
Shared filesystem means withholding is procedural, not technical isolation.
No independently certified chronology or candidate-unseen audit.
Deterministic PNG reproduction verified in current NumPy/Pillow/runtime; cross-version/architecture behavior unproven.
Synthetic construction is not real-course accuracy, physical corridor identity, meter scale, endpoint ownership or human acceptance.
Actual candidate outputs may expose fewer channels than evaluation plan requests; report unavailable rather than inventing them.
Private geometry details are in reviewer-owned generated fixtures and construction evidence; public summary omits them.
